toolchain: bs-recomp (own SH-4 to C++20 static recompiler)
approach: Static recompilation of the SH-4 executable to C++20, with the Dreamcast subsystems replaced one by one by native PC implementations, each validated against the original game running in Flycast.
help: Testing full playthroughs on different PCs and controllers
notes: Runs on Windows from the user's own disc (CDI image of NTSC-U T13001N V1.000; the executable inside is checked by SHA-256). Native file system, controls (keyboard, Xbox controller), saves, movies and audio (effects, voices, Manatee music, AICA DSP) are done and on by default; English subtitles by default (mod package). Rendering uses Vulkan by default, with a software fallback on the same native command list. The simulated console layer (BIOS, GD-ROM, Maple, AICA, TA, VRAM) is out of the product; the recompiled code still targets the original hardware addresses, served by native services. A full playthrough proof is still pending. Next: Remastered edition, then mods and Linux. No game data is included.
